{{Jbocre/en}}

==Semantics of forethought logical connectives==
The [[zantufa jonma'o|forethought connectives]] of [[zantufa|Zantufa]] that is a series of parsers for unofficial Lojban are much more expressive than that of official grammar.

Zantufa is syntactic parser, and it does not fix rules for sematics by itself.

Here is only a suggestion of semantics of the forethought logical connectives in order to gain profit from expressiveness of Zantufa grammar.

The sentences in Lojban here follow the grammar of [http://guskant.github.io/gerna_cipra/zantufa-1.16.html Zantufa_1.16].

==List of symbols used on this page==

{| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;"
|-
! Symbol
! Definition
|-
| ¬P
| '''na ku''' P
|-
| P ∨ Q
| P '''i ja''' Q
|-
| [[Image:ija.png|alt="so'i zo ja"]]
| ((((P<sub>0</sub> ∨ P<sub>1</sub>) ∨ P<sub>2</sub>) ∨ ...) ∨ P<sub>n</sub>)
|-
| P ∧ Q
| P '''i je''' Q
|-
| [[Image:ije.png|alt="so'i zo je"]]
| ((((P<sub>0</sub> ∧ P<sub>1</sub>) ∧ P<sub>2</sub>) ∧ ...) ∧ P<sub>n</sub>)
|-
| P ↔ Q
| P '''i jo''' Q
|-
| [[Image:ijo.png|alt="so'i zo jo"]]
| ((((P<sub>0</sub> ↔ P<sub>1</sub>) ↔ P<sub>2</sub>) ↔ ...) ↔ P<sub>n</sub>)
|-
| P ⊕ Q
| P '''i jonai''' Q
|-
| [[Image:ijonai.png|alt="so'i lu jonai li'u"]]
| ((((P<sub>0</sub> ⊕ P<sub>1</sub>) ⊕ P<sub>2</sub>) ⊕ ...) ⊕ P<sub>n</sub>)
|-
| P ⊏ Q
| P '''i ju''' Q
|-
| [[Image:iju.png|alt="so'i zo ju"]]
| ((((P<sub>0</sub> ⊏ P<sub>1</sub>) ⊏ P<sub>2</sub>) ⊏ ...) ⊏ P<sub>n</sub>) <br /> = P<sub>0</sub>
|-
| P ⊐ Q
| P '''i se ju''' Q
|-
| [[Image:iseju.png|alt="so'i lu seju li'u"]]
| ((((P<sub>0</sub> ⊐ P<sub>1</sub>) ⊐ P<sub>2</sub>) ⊐ ...) ⊐ P<sub>n</sub>) <br /> = P<sub>n</sub>
|}

In the following explanation, examples for 3-ary or 4-ary connection are sometimes accompanied with a truth value table. 
The falseness is represented by 0; the truth is represented by 1.

Examples for 3-ary connection are sometimes accompanied with a Venn diagram. 
<span style="background-color:#FFFFFF;">White color represents falseness</span>; <span style="background-color:#FFAB58;">orange color represents truth</span>.

===go nai bo A gi B gi C gi ...===
====Definition====
It is defined recursively as follows.

{|
|+ style="text-align:left;font-weight:bold;" | 2-ary case of P<sub>0</sub> and P<sub>1</sub>:
|-
| 
|'''go nai bo''' P<sub>0</sub> '''gi''' P<sub>1</sub> ('''gi'i''')
|-
|=
|'''go nai''' P<sub>0</sub> '''gi''' P<sub>1</sub> ('''gi'i''')
|-
|=
| P<sub>0</sub> ⊕ P<sub>1</sub>
|-
|=
| ¬P<sub>0</sub> ↔ P<sub>1</sub>
|}

{|
